prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 airbrushed painting in the style of a 1980s VHS horror video box cover, with worn cardboard edges, a creased spine and tracking-scratch scuffs. Centre: a loaf of plain white bread on a corner-shop counter, glowing under a single hard spotlight, its price sticker reading "£50" in dripping red horror lettering. Behind and above it, a monstrous shadow fills the whole sky of the painting, its outline formed by a giant money printing press, rollers turning, sheets of banknotes pouring like storm clouds over a tiny row of terraced houses; in front of the press stands an empty leather chair. No face anywhere, only the silhouette. Lurid red and electric blue palette, painted rim light, saturated and pulpy. Thanks.
